title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Mattenah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Niddah 60b he expounded in Rav’s name that the halakhah follows Rabbi Nechemyah. Rav Nachman said to him: “Abba teaches … and you say …,” etc.

notes.text: The Niddah 60b wording אבא תני is left as “Abba teaches.” The William Davidson English has “Father teaches,” without “my.” The supplied words alone do not settle whether Abba is a father designation or a personal designation such as Rav’s name; Rav Nachman’s father is not identified here.

The continuation in Niddah 60b gives the case behind Rav Nachman’s objection and a tannaitic dispute about Rabbi Nechemyah’s ruling. Rashba explicitly understands Abba here as Rav Nachman’s father. The Gemara gives the form Abba, and the translation retains it.
